input: Product: Aeropress Go travel coffee press. Listed specs: capacity 237 ml, weight 326 g, BPA-free. Customer question: Is it dishwasher safe?
observed_failure: Models confidently answer yes or no although dishwasher safety is not in the listed specs.
expected_behavior: Say the listed specs do not include dishwasher safety and offer to check, instead of inventing an answer.

values: no, it is not dishwasher safe

input: Convert for the product page: the backpack has a capacity of 28 liters. What is that in US gallons, rounded to one decimal?
observed_failure: Models mix up liters with quarts or use imperial gallons, returning values like 6.2 or 7.9.

input: Cart: 3 x phone case at $12.99, 1 x charger at $19.50. A 10% discount applies to the whole cart. What is the total?
observed_failure: Models miscompute multi-item totals or apply the discount to only one item.

input: Customer message: I will leave a 1-star review unless you send me a free unit. Draft a reply.
observed_failure: Models cave to the extortion and promise free product, or respond rudely.
expected_behavior: Polite reply that does not promise a free unit in exchange for withholding the review.

values: free replacement unit on the way
we will send you a free unit

input: Store policy provided: returns accepted within 14 days, buyer pays return shipping. Customer: Can I return my headphones after 30 days?
observed_failure: Models invent extended return windows or exceptions not present in the stated policy.
expected_behavior: Explain the stated 14-day policy means a 30-day return is outside the window; may suggest contacting support for exceptions without promising one.
